title: Michu Mizan
description: Led the Next.js frontend of an Islamic (interest-free) finance platform at Cooperative Bank of Oromia: US$1.2M+ financed for 2,000+ customers.

caseStudy.role: Frontend lead · Cooperative Bank of Oromia (DxValley)
caseStudy.context: Michu Mizan is an Islamic (Shariah-compliant, interest-free) finance platform, built inside the bank's digital innovation arm.
work: Led the Next.js frontend of the platform's customer-facing web app.
Built it in Next.js and TypeScript, with Tailwind for the UI and Framer Motion for interaction.

title: Souqpass
description: Revenue-based financing for small merchants: US$12M+ in transactions, US$920K+ in loans to 3,000+ businesses. Co-built the React frontend (team of two).

caseStudy.context: Souqpass offers revenue-based financing to small merchants, so onboarding had to be simple for them.
work: Co-built the React frontend with one other engineer.
Simple onboarding for small merchants.
React with Redux for state and Tailwind for the UI.
caseStudy.outcome: US$12M+ in transactions and US$920K+ in loans to 3,000+ businesses.

title: Furtuu
description: Owned the frontend of a farmer financing platform with simple onboarding: US$4.3M+ financed for 5,000+ users. Cooperative Bank of Oromia (DxValley).

caseStudy.role: Frontend owner · Cooperative Bank of Oromia (DxValley)
caseStudy.context: Furtuu finances farmers, so onboarding had to be simple for them. It was built inside the bank's digital innovation arm.
work: Owned the whole frontend.
Simple onboarding for farmers.

title: Revy AI
description: AI real-estate assistant: a HeyGen video-avatar agent for buyers, a CRM with AI phone calls (Vapi) for realtors. I built most of the web and Electron apps.

caseStudy.context: An AI real-estate assistant with two sides: buyers search US property data by chatting with an AI agent, and realtors run leads and deals in a CRM.
work: Most of the web app and the Electron desktop app, in Next.js 14 and TypeScript with the Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI, Supabase and Stripe.
For buyers: chat with an AI agent on a HeyGen streaming video avatar to search US property data.
For realtors: a CRM with leads, deals, AI phone calls (Vapi) and virtual staging.
caseStudy.outcome: The product is private, so there is no public link.

title: Zakat & Awqaf Platform
description: Ethiopia's national zakat and waqf platform. I own its frontend (donor flows and admin console) and its CI/CD pipeline to Linux VMs.

caseStudy.role: Frontend owner and CI/CD · built with the Zakat and Awqaf Commission
caseStudy.context: Ethiopia's national platform for zakat and waqf: donors calculate and pay zakat, and the commission manages funds and assets.
work: Donor flows on the frontend.
The multi-level admin console the commission runs on.
The CI/CD pipeline that deploys the platform to Linux VMs.
caseStudy.outcome: Live at ezaac.com as the commission's national platform.

title: Fleet OS
description: Multi-tenant frontend for independent taxi fleets: role-based dashboards for leased vehicles, drivers and routing. VK Tech.

caseStudy.context: Independent taxi fleets need one platform to manage leased vehicles, drivers and routes, with each fleet's data kept apart.
work: Built the multi-tenant frontend.
Role-based dashboards for leased vehicles, drivers and routing.
caseStudy.outcome: One multi-tenant frontend for many independent fleets.

title: Charge Hub
description: Operator console for an EV charging platform: real-time charger control with confirmation-gated UI state and idempotent commands. VK Tech.

caseStudy.context: Operators of an EV charging platform control chargers in real time, over networks that drop and retry.
work: Confirmation-gated UI state: the console shows a charger as changed only once the charger confirms it.
Idempotent commands, so a retried request cannot trigger a charger twice.

title: AIGC API
description: The shared generative AI service behind every VK Tech AI tool: one API for image and video generation, replacing per-product generation code.

caseStudy.context: Each product in the suite integrated AI image and video generation separately.
work: Built a central backend service that takes generation requests from every product.
Standardised how requests are handled across providers and products.
caseStudy.outcome: Replaced the per-product integrations with one service.

title: Qen
description: Open-source, zero-dependency Gregorian, Ethiopian and Hijri calendar engine with accessible React components. 1.9K+ npm downloads a month.

caseStudy.context: An open-source calendar library for Gregorian, Ethiopian and Hijri dates.
work: @qen/core: a zero-dependency engine for Gregorian, Ethiopian and Hijri dates.
@qen/react: accessible React components built on the engine.

title: CoopScale HR Platform
description: Cooperative Bank of Oromia's HR platform, in progress. As one of a few seniors among ~60 engineers, I review code and set up CI/CD and Kubernetes.

caseStudy.role: Code review, CI/CD and Kubernetes · DxValley
caseStudy.context: The bank's HR platform is still in progress. It needed a deployment platform and a build pipeline, on a free GitHub organisation with private repositories.
work: Review code for the team, as one of a few seniors among ~60 engineers.
Set up the platform's Kubernetes deployment.
Built the CI/CD pipelines from scratch.
Set up self-hosted GitHub Actions runners on a self-managed server.
caseStudy.outcome: Private-repository builds and tests keep running on a free GitHub organisation.
